name: iptv
description:
📺 IPTV for Samsung Tizen

IPTV Player for Samsung Tizen TVs

Xtream Codes • M3U • M3U8 • HLS • Remote Control

scripts.start: rm -rf /tmp/iptv-tizen-build ./Debug && tizen uninstall -p Vk7ES0fDwd.iptv && tizen build-web -out /tmp/iptv-tizen-build && tizen package -t wgt -s mobilkod -o ./Debug && tizen install -n ./Debug/iptv.wgt && sdb shell 0 debug Vk7ES0fDwd.iptv
